about_short_description.short_description: Goody makes sending gifts as easy as sending a text.

product.name: Goody Business Gifting Platform
product.description: A web-based platform for sending physical gifts and digital cards to employees, clients, prospects, and other recipients without collecting shipping addresses upfront.

product.name: Bulk Gifting
product.description: A service for coordinating and sending gifts to large recipient groups, with recipient uploads, centralized budgeting, messaging, and address collection handled through the gifting workflow.

product.name: Branded Swag
product.description: A catalog and fulfillment service for company-logo merchandise, including apparel, drinkware, bags, technology accessories, food, and office products, with on-demand printing for many items.

product.name: Gift of Choice
product.description: A gifting option that lets senders set a price point while recipients choose an eligible gift from Goody’s catalog and provide their own shipping information.

product.name: Custom Collections
product.description: A feature for assembling curated sets of gifts within Goody so senders can offer recipients a defined selection aligned with a budget, audience, or occasion.

product.name: Company Stores
product.description: A hosted online store service for branded merchandise where employees, customers, or fans can shop from a company’s approved swag catalog and pay for their own orders.
